categories.title: Hot Spring
categories.info: Hot Springs become available after Main Order 026.  Bathe in the [Miracle Spring](https://mapgenie.io/death-stranding-2/maps/australia?locationIds=462952) and activate the action "Put Bucket on Head".  Then speak with The Hydrologist to unlock the Hot Spring Digger.

categories.title: Magellan Dock
categories.info: DHV Magellan Docking Areas are locations where the Magellan can fast travel to.  The Chiral Network must first be connected to a region for a fast travel location to be unlocked.
